correctness.rationale: The 90 vertices and distance<=2 edges are generated directly. Each of 72 orbit cliques is checked exactly, each vertex receives clique-cover numerator at least 19, and total numerator 360. The incidence inequality gives 19|C|<=360, hence <=18. A separate cyclic-relabeling orbit of six representatives has 18 distinct vertices at pairwise distance>=3, verified with two independent distance algorithms (BFS and stable-rank inversion counts). All 8,100 ordered distances agree; no numerical optimization result is used in the proof.
